name: Houkago Ouji ~Anata wa Dare to Kaeru?~
original_name: 放課後王子～貴女は誰と帰る？～
source:
Aikawa Hibiki is an ordinary high school girl. Suddenly, Jinguuji Yukihiko, the school's idol, asks if she would like to go home with him...!
